title: Audio language dropdown
summary: Added a primary default audio language dropdown with top-spoken-language labels and three-letter codes while preserving the existing PreferredDefaultAudioLanguages settings payload.
reason: Audio language selection was a free-text field, making common language choices easy to mistype and hiding the three-letter language tag that the media pipeline compares against track metadata.
behavior_before: The Audio settings builder exposed PreferredDefaultAudioLanguages as a free-text comma-separated input with examples like english and eng.
behavior_after: The Audio settings builder exposes a primary default-language dropdown, displays full language names plus three-letter codes, normalizes legacy saved names such as english to eng, and still writes PreferredDefaultAudioLanguages as a list for backend Preview/Save.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static_settings.py to pin the Audio language dropdown and list-select builder behavior.
